documents.title: UAMS Academic Affairs Policy 2.1.6: UAMS Artificial Intelligence Generative Tool Use Policy
documents.summary: A campus-wide policy for a health-sciences university covering academic work, research, education and clinical boundaries. Students may use generative AI only where the course instructor allows it, with instructors choosing among prohibited, restricted or unrestricted levels; all users must disclose and verify AI use, and tools need AI Governance Committee approval. It also bars instructors from putting student work into AI or detectors without permission and requires annual AI training.
documents.stance_why: Section IV says student GAI use 'must be authorized by the course faculty' and that faculty should say whether it is 'prohibited', 'restricted' or 'unrestricted'. The policy offers these three tiers and leaves the choice to each instructor, so the document delegates rather than itself prohibiting or permitting.
